title: Thats What Friends Are For Johnny Mathis Deniece Williams CD Columbia Music
descriptionText: "That's What Friends Are For" is a soulful CD released in 1987 by Columbia Music, featuring the talents of Johnny Mathis and Deniece Williams. This album, with a run time of 32 minutes, falls under the genres of pop, soul, and R&B & Soul, showcasing a blend of emotive and soulful sounds. The CD format allows for easy listening and enjoyment of the heartfelt songs that encapsulate the essence of friendship and companionship.
